# Does the saved workspace exploit recoverable natural dependencies?

This is an inference-only diagnostic after the fixed one-step reader failed its broad continuation comparison and source-separated calibration chose zero contribution. Do not extend that training recipe or sweep its mixer. The new owner request is to locate the failure before another fit.

Freeze source-selection rules before any model score. Reuse the149 syntax-selected natural-code dependency candidates and135 source-verified natural arithmetic chains already used as development material by earlier small models. Reconstruct original bytes and retokenize with the pinned OLMo tokenizer;never reinterpret old token IDs. No task instruction,prompt template,teacher answer or generated program. Targets are exact original source substrings. Arithmetic verification supplies no labels. Reused development sources and possible upstream foundation exposure prevent a fresh-confirmation claim.

Primary families: (1) code identifier reuse after a unique dominating local binding,with binder visible in full context and absent from the last128 tokens;this is a lexical-dependency control,not multi-step reasoning. (2) final source arithmetic conclusions after human-written intermediate steps,with all operands/work present in the last128 source tokens and answer absent from prior local literal values. Exploratory family: a newly derived numeral in the first human simplification,not a literal in its source premise. All expression values/steps must pass the existing exact bounded arithmetic checker. Use at most one target per source chain per family. Reject target spans longer than16 OLMo tokens,ambiguous token edges,missing antecedents or altered source bytes. No selection by loss or model correctness.

Code full context retains up to1008 prefix tokens,including the binding;short context retains the exact final128 and excludes it. Math full context retains128 natural source tokens,including the verified chain;the ablated context retains only the final source token before the target,removing operand/work information. Keep true target tokens unchanged. Retain original RoPE positions under context truncation. Fixed physical1024 positions are right-padded after authentic input;causality must make future padding irrelevant. Long code contexts generalize beyond the160-position workspace continuation regime and must be labeled as such. Math stays within its trained context-length range.

Split source groups into two diagnostic cohorts by the low bit of their group hash before scoring. Keep every eligible case from the fixed parent panels;do not refill by generating data. Adequate coverage requires at least32 cases and12 source groups in each cohort for a primary family. Insufficient coverage is reported. The two cohorts are development replication,not independent training seeds or confirmation.

Evaluate C0,uniform ordinary940,latent800 and trained constant-query800,without updates. Use the original one-step alpha.5 reader,temperature1 only;no calibration or unsupported extra latent steps. First score ordinary prediction with and without the relevant context. A useful positive control requires full context to reduce ordinary answer NLL by at least.1nats,with a conditional source-group95% interval above zero,in both adequate cohorts. Then test within-latent raw-minus-workspace answer NLL. A promising mechanism slice requires gain>=.03nats and lower source-group interval>0 in both cohorts,plus the context-use positive control. Compare the same target with ordinary and the trained constant control too. A slice result does not replace the failed broad efficiency result. No per-case hindsight depth selection is a deployment policy.

Report first-target NLL,whole-source-target NLL,teacher-forced token/top1 and exact-span accuracy,raw/workspace distribution KL,entropy,beneficial/harmful argmax flips,and initial/refined-state cosine/relative norm difference. Context ablation recomputes all states and KV. State convergence or corruption sensitivity alone is not proof of reasoning. All unchanged model parameters and source hashes must be checked;no optimizer exists in the evaluator.

Before Native scoring,CPU fixtures verify target/token alignment,padding and context-ablation invariance,position preservation,causal workspace masking and independently computed metrics. A full-size independent HF dense2D reference on authentic frozen cases must agree with Native at the new1024 shape before any panel score. Preserve the2% gradient gates from training;this zero-update forward comparison additionally requires target NLL/logit agreement within declared numerical tolerance. Use all16chips/64ranks only after CPU correctness. Keep192GiB worker,512GiB host and35GiB filesystem reserves,fail-closed compilation and bounded original phase deadlines. Freeze a measured finite evaluation budget after source coverage is known;no scientific fit is admitted.

If ordinary reliably exploits the supplied context but the second pass fails on both primary families,stop this workspace architecture. If ordinary itself cannot exploit the context,the prerequisite is absent and extra-pass failure does not isolate the operator. If a family replicates a useful effect,write a new bounded mechanism experiment around it;do not immediately scale or deploy a router.
